scientific_integrity: One elementary theorem and one supporting extremal lemma. All new arithmetic is exact and full proof arguments are included. Independent mathematical validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Classifies unique best four-term greedy underapproximations only for real theta > 629/630 and proves failure on (599/600,629/630]. Does not determine optimal tuples farther below; equivalence in unindexed historical literature cannot be excluded. Uses classical three-term Sylvester extremum and an exhaustively bounded seven-row rational certificate.
title: The sharp near-one stability threshold for four-term Egyptian underapproximation
